description: Out-of-scope: `Request` direction. Charter post-#244 Direction table binds Requestor=PR-author on Request comments — so the canonical Request shape has Requestor.lastname matching the branch-author.lastname. Under the verdict-only inverted heuristic this would BLOCK (Virtanen == Virtanen), but path-2 narrowing returns None for non-verdict directions and lets the Request through. This is the false-positive surface the narrowing eliminates — and it's now also the charter-canonical Request shape, not a contrived swap.
command:
gh pr comment 42 --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Requestor: Aino Virtanen
Requestee: Nadia Khoury
RequestOrReplied: Request
EOF
)"
